review_questions: Independently falsify the repaired clean Slice5 integration candidate. Do not inherit authority from any prior PASS or BOUNDED_PASS.

Verify the new Slice3 v2 receipt adapter does not trust caller-supplied identities or widen v1 authority, and that it only enriches verified v1 success results with lineage already proven by Slice2 and the validated Slice3 contract.
Verify the new true composition test actually traverses real Slice1→Slice2→Slice3 v2→Slice4→Slice5 boundaries and does not silently substitute synthetic receipts between them.
Verify CI run 34250241541 is bound to exact candidate 964ba7162fa3950b93576f553f26b83580555bc2 and all accepted Slice1-4 regressions, true composition, and repaired Slice5 tests pass.
Re-test Slice5 audit false-green protections and terminal-authority separation.

Search specifically for new cross-slice receipt incompatibilities, lineage laundering, idempotency/replay inconsistencies introduced by v2 enrichment, synthetic fixture masking, stale candidate evidence, and overclaim.
Return PASS only if every mandatory dimension is TESTED_SUPPORTED and no MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL finding remains.

evidence_refs.ref: Prior clean candidate c79c0bcf56717b7c27e89280cf65461b48ce479c passed fresh R2 but R3 returned BOUNDED_PASS because the actual R2-to-R3 handoff was not materialized and no single true Slice1-to-Slice5 composition test existed. That prior review grants no authority to this repaired candidate.

The first true Slice1-to-Slice5 composition attempt exposed a real Slice3-to-Slice4 receipt interface defect: accepted Slice4 requires success, project_id, task_id, execution_id, and plan_step_id while accepted Slice3 v1 success results omitted them. This was classified CROSS_SLICE_RECEIPT_INTERFACE_DEFECT / PRIOR_FALSE_GREEN_COVERAGE_GAP and preregistered before repair.

The narrow repair preserves Slice3 v1 and adds integrated_governed_mvp_repository_gateway_v2.py, which enriches only verified v1 success results with success=true and lineage reconstructed from already-verified Slice2 capability/effect identity plus the validated Slice3 effect contract. Terminal and release authority remain false. Candidate 964ba7162fa3950b93576f553f26b83580555bc2 passes the real composition test and all accepted regressions in run 34250241541.

Earlier candidate attempts c5829e6f5c9306d6a381c5c400013cccff99b375, 2922a9644534cb249219a12b83ecd0980624176f, and ff3ba2268bc6d0ce3d909459995803b6095b7d9b failed during true composition due respectively to missing Slice3 receipt identities, missing success marker, and a test-fixture misuse of Slice5 TransitionResult. These failures retain authority NONE and are preserved as repair history.

required_review_dimensions.description: Exact repaired candidate is on the clean current-main integration lineage and contains only the bounded accepted foundation, Slice5, and preregistered cross-slice repair/test changes.
Accepted Slice1 and Slice2 behavior remains green and preserves capability/qualification/idempotency/crash-replay and terminal-authority boundaries.
Accepted Slice3 v1 remains regression-clean and v2 only reconstructs already-verified success/lineage fields required by Slice4 without widening mutation or authority semantics.
Accepted Slice4 consumes the real repaired Slice3 receipt rather than a synthetic substitute, while preserving executable/workspace/env/result containment and no terminal authority.

A single deterministic scenario actually traverses real Slice1 decision, Slice2 execution receipt, repaired real Slice3 repository mutation receipt, Slice4 tool execution, and Slice5 authoritative ledger transition/audit.
Slice5 v2 retains atomic ledger semantics plus command-digest reconstruction, current-state digest verification, replay lineage reconciliation, and tamper detection.
Run 34250241541 is bound to exact candidate 964ba7162fa3950b93576f553f26b83580555bc2 and all separate regressions, real composition, and Slice5 tests pass.
Cross-slice identities are derived from verified upstream evidence/contracts and cannot mint release/deploy/merge/completion authority or launder caller/model claims.
Claims remain bounded to local reference mechanisms; no production durability, distributed consensus, cryptographic tamper-proofing, or production-readiness claim is created.
Adversarial inspection finds no remaining material synthetic-fixture substitution, interface mismatch, topology, lineage, regression, tamper, or authority-bypass false green.
